# Tissue, plasma, and immunity.<br>One molecular view of colitis.

We are studying whether **paired tissue and plasma DNA methylation** and **serum secretory immunoglobulin A (sIgA)** reveal a coherent disease-state fingerprint across high-risk ulcerative colitis, colorectal cancer, and healthy comparators.

[See the study design](research.qmd){.btn .btn-light .btn-lg} [Compare the approaches](approach.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-light .btn-lg}

## Rooted in cellular and molecular immunology

This project sits within the scientific environment of **InMubo**, the Cellular and Molecular Immunology Research Group at Universidad El Bosque, whose work spans cancer immunology, mucosal immunity and infection, autoimmunity, systemic inflammation, and new research technologies.
:::

::: {.section-intro}
## The question behind the project

Long-standing ulcerative colitis creates a setting of persistent inflammation, epithelial injury, repair, and—in some patients—neoplastic transformation. Current surveillance is essential, but the project asks whether molecular signals in blood and colon tissue can add a more biologically informative layer.
:::

:::: {.signal-grid}
::: {.signal-card .signal-card-methylation}
::: {.signal-number}
01
:::
### DNA methylation

An epigenetic record of gene regulation and cellular state. The project compares methylation profiles in plasma cell-free DNA and colonic tissue across ulcerative colitis, colorectal cancer, and healthy comparator groups.

[How methylation is studied →](approach.qmd#methylation-an-epigenetic-signal)
:::

::: {.signal-bridge}
**Integrated interpretation**

Do immune dysfunction and epigenetic change move together—and does their combination distinguish higher-risk biology?
:::

::: {.signal-card .signal-card-siga}
::: {.signal-number}
02
:::
### Secretory IgA

A mucosal immune signal involved in limiting exposure to commensal microbes and shaping intestinal immune responses. The study examines serum sIgA alongside methylation and inflammatory markers.

[How sIgA complements methylation →](approach.qmd#siga-a-mucosal-immune-signal)
:::
::::

[Explore how the two data streams are produced →](sequencing-methods.qmd) · [Understand the sIgA assay and rationale →](siga-methods.qmd)
